zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空開通第 50 條不經停航線創紀錄
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空第50條不經停航線；聖地牙哥運力增38%新增230萬座位
body: 阿拉斯加航空宣佈將從一個主要美國機場開通第 50 條不經停航線，創下該航司航線網絡的新紀錄。
根據 Simple Flying 報導，該航司在聖地牙哥的運力於 2026 年增長 38%，新增 230 萬個座位。
消息於 2026 年 9 月 9 日由 Simple Flying 發布。
這項擴展使阿拉斯加航空在西海岸樞紐的座位供應大幅增加，顯示其持續增長的趨勢。
新增的 230 萬個座位將為旅客提供更多選擇，並強化該航線網絡的競爭力。

en.title: Alaska Airlines launches record 50th nonstop route from major US airport
en.summary: Alaska Airlines adds 50th nonstop route; San Diego capacity up 38% adding 2.3 million seats
body: Alaska Airlines announced that it will introduce its fiftieth nonstop route from a major United States airport, marking a record for the carrier’s route network.
Simple Flying reported that the airline’s capacity at San Diego increased by thirty‑eight percent in 2026, adding 2.3 million seats to the schedule.
The announcement was released on September 9, 2026, according to the Simple Flying article dated the same day.
The 38 percent capacity growth represents a significant increase in available seats for passengers traveling through San Diego.
This increase brings the total added seats to 2.3 million for the year, reinforcing the carrier’s expanding presence at the West Coast hub.

zh.title: EUROCONTROL簽署NewPENS合約延長並籌備PENS 3.0
body: EUROCONTROL於2026年9月9日舉辦PENS（泛歐網路服務）策略研討會，匯集歐洲各地航空利害關係人，討論服務持續與下一代網路PENS 3.0的準備工作。
研討會上簽署現有NewPENS合約（自2018年由BT營運）的延長協議，確保當前服務的營運穩定，並為PENS 3.0的治理、採購與服務框架提供過渡期。
NewPENS目前連接44個國家的逾48個使用者，包括航管服務提供者、ATM組織、機場、航空公司、軍事組織與氣象服務。PENS 3.0規劃採雙核心架構，以提升歐洲航空通信網路的韌性與成本效益。
EUROCONTROL表示，延長合約旨在確保服務持續，並為下一代網路奠定基礎，相關過渡以協調、透明且由社群驅動的方式進行。

en.title: EUROCONTROL signs NewPENS contract extension, prepares PENS 3.0
en.summary: EUROCONTROL signs NewPENS extension; prepares PENS 3.0 transition
body: EUROCONTROL held a strategic symposium on the Pan-European Network Service (PENS) on September 9, 2026, bringing together aviation stakeholders to discuss service continuity and the next-generation network, PENS 3.0.

The symposium marked the signing of an extension to the existing NewPENS contract with BT, which operates the service since 2018, securing operational stability and providing a transition period for PENS 3.0.
NewPENS connects stakeholders across 44 countries and supports over 48 users. PENS 3.0 is designed with a planned dual-core architecture to enhance network resilience and cost efficiency.
EUROCONTROL leads procurement for the service and relies on NewPENS for its Network Manager role, supporting safe and efficient cross-border air traffic management information exchange.
